subject: Annual retainer: billing lifecycle, SOW custody & VAT attestation
messages:
From: Sarah Olmsted <sarah.olmsted@acme-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-06-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: Redwood annual retainer — invoicing cadence & VAT evidence request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We are ready to move forward with the annual retainer for the committed spend, but our procurement team needs a couple of things before we can issue the PO and wire the first tranche: 

- Clear invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly/annual) and expected invoice numbers for our AP system.
- A signed SOW or purchase confirmation showing the total committed amount and start date.
- VAT evidence for services in UK and Germany (we handle VAT reclaiming but need supplier attestations).
- Bank wiring instructions and Redwood's tax/VAT registration numbers.

Can you confirm the proposed schedule and attach the current SOW + any VAT proof we can provide to our tax team?

We'd like to close this week if possible — Sarah O. (Finance) will be the PO owner.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Olmsted
Head of Procurement — Acme Corporation

Attachments: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Olmsted <sarah.olmsted@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood annual retainer — invoicing cadence & VAT evidence request

Hi Sarah —

Great to hear — congrats on the internal sign-off momentum. Proposed approach (we can adapt):

1) Invoice cadence: we issue an annual invoice for the full committed amount, with monthly drawdown reports to reconcile usage against the retainer. Alternatively, if your AP prefers smaller invoices we can do quarterly invoices (split into 4 equal invoices) with a single annual reconciliation.

2) SOW: attaching the current SOW for signature. We can capture billing schedule in Annex A so the document is PO-friendly.

3) VAT evidence: attaching our country-level VAT matrix (spreadsheet) showing registered entities and VAT numbers for UK/DE/FR. Naomi can add copies of certificates if needed.

4) Bank details & tax ids: included in the attached wire instructions PDF.

Next steps for us:
- Please confirm if Acme wants a single annual invoice or quarterly installments.
- If quarterly, confirm preferred invoice months (we typically do Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct alignment, but can do a custom schedule).
- If you can provide the PO number in reply, we'll update the SOW and route DocuSign.

I've copied Naomi (tax) and Laura (revenue ops) to help close this out.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Revenue — Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME-Retainer-SOW-v1.3.pdf (application/pdf); VAT-Evidence-by-country.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); Redwood-bank-wire-instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Sarah Olmsted <sarah.olmsted@acme-corp.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-06-09T08:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood annual retainer — invoicing cadence & VAT evidence request

Thanks Hannah —

Quarterly invoices would work best for our payment windows. Can you do Apr/Jul/Oct/Jan? We'll give you PO #PO-ACME-9923 by end of day. For VAT, our tax team specifically wants supplier VAT registration copies for the UK and Germany plus confirmation whether Redwood will charge VAT on the invoices or if Acme should self-assess.

Looping in our AP lead, finance@acme-corp.com, for banking alignment.

Hi Sarah, Hannah —

Quick note from tax: we maintain active VAT registration in the UK (GB 123 4567 89) and Germany (DE 987654321). We typically apply local VAT where required; however for B2B services within the EU, in many cases we zero-rate and the buyer self-assesses (reverse charge). To speed your tax team's review, I've attached
- a spreadsheet with the registration numbers and registered addresses by country, and
- scanned VAT registration certificates for UK & DE (embedded in the spreadsheet).

If Acme's tax team needs signed supplier declarations on company letterhead, we can provide a short attestation PDF — flag if you need that.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Tax & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-06-12T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood annual retainer — invoicing cadence & VAT evidence request

Sarah / team —

Thanks for confirming quarterlies. Two operational items from revops before we issue invoices: 

1) Invoice numbering: we will generate 4 invoice documents (one per quarter) referencing the PO; please confirm the PO will be included on the invoice header to satisfy your AP.
2) Drawdown reports: attached is our standard monthly drawdown template showing starting balance, monthly consumption (tokens/minutes/requests), and remaining retainer balance. We will produce this as a CSV each month and a rolled-up PDF each quarter.
3) DocuSign: I'll send a DocuSign envelope for the SOW once PO is attached to the SOW. If Acme requires a specific sig block language for procurement, please paste it in reply.

On wire details: Laura, please confirm the vintage bank account in the wire PDF is still valid for Q3 invoices.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: monthly-drawdown-template.csv (text/csv)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Olmsted <sarah.olmsted@acme-corp.com>, finance@acme-corp.com
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T17:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood annual retainer — invoicing cadence & VAT evidence request

Sarah —

Confirming the following so AP can queue payments once the PO is received:

- Invoice schedule: Quarterly invoices issued in Jul 2026 (invoice for Apr–Jun pro-rata), Oct 2026, Jan 2027, Apr 2027. We will accept the PO as PO-ACME-9923 and will include it on every invoice header.
- Invoice numbers: Redwood will prefix with RWI-ACME-YYYY-Qx (e.g., RWI-ACME-2026-Q3-001).
- Drawdown & reconciliation: monthly CSVs delivered to finance@acme-corp.com on the 5th of each month; quarterly PDF summary within 7 business days of quarter close.
- VAT treatment: Naomi's guidance stands — where VAT applies we'll charge it; otherwise we'll indicate reverse-charge on the invoice. If you need signed attestation, we'll provide a one-page supplier letter.
- Bank details: the wire instructions in our PDF are current. For payments via Stripe or ACH, please CC stripe-invoice@payments.acme.com so we can match remittance.

I will kick off the DocuSign once we receive PO-ACME-9923. Ben will attach the drawdown template to the first monthly delivery.

Thank you — looking forward to getting this live.

Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
